        "contents": "# Codex MCP Server - 完全ガイド\n\n**バージョン**: 0.47.0-alpha.1  \n**最終更新**: 2025-10-12  \n**ステータス**: ✅ 本番環境テスト成功\n\n---\n\n## 📋 概要\n\nCodex MCP Server は、Model Context Protocol (MCP) を実装した stdio ベースのサーバーで、IDE（Cursor/Windsurf）やMCPクライアントに以下の機能を提供します：\n\n- **SubAgent管理** - 8種類のAIエージェントの起動・管理\n- **Deep Research** - 計画的な調査とレポート生成\n- **Supervisor** - マルチエージェント調整\n- **Custom Command** - カスタムコマンド実行\n- **Lifecycle Hooks** - イベント駆動処理\n\n---\n\n## 🚀 インストール状況\n\n### グローバルインストール ✅\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# インストール先\nC:\\Users\\downl\\.cargo\\bin\\codex-mcp-server.exe\n\n# 確認\nGet-Command codex-mcp-server\n# Name: codex-mcp-server.exe\n# Source: C:\\Users\\downl\\.cargo\\bin\\codex-mcp-server.exe\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### ビルド情報\n\n| 項目 | 値 |\n|------|-----|\n| **Rustバージョン** | 1.90.0 (stable) |\n| **ビルド時間** | 8分20秒 |\n| **バイナリサイズ** | 約45 MB |\n| **最終ビルド** | 2025-10-12 20:00 JST |\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 利用可能なツール（7種類）\n\n### 1. codex ✅\n**Codex セッション実行**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"name\": \"codex\",\n  \"description\": \"Run a Codex session. Arc&lt;CollaborationStore&gt; {\n        self.collaboration_store.clone()\n    }\n\n    /// Codex MCP Serverをstdio モードで起動\n    async fn spawn_codex_mcp_server(&amp;self) -&gt; Result&lt;Arc&lt;RmcpClient&gt;&gt;         "contents": "//! MCP Integration Manager\n//!\n//! Manages enhanced MCP server integrations including Serena, ArXiv, GitHub, etc.\n//!\n//! Enhanced with Windows 11 25H2 AI integration and VR/AR support\n\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::sync::Mutex;\n\n#[cfg(all(target_os = \"windows\", feature = \"windows-ai\"))]\nuse crate::windows_ai_integration::WindowsAiOptions;\n#[cfg(all(target_os = \"windows\", feature = \"windows-ai\"))]\nuse crate::windows_ai_integration::execute_with_windows_ai;\n\n/// Enhanced MCP server configuration\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct EnhancedMcpServer {\n    /// Server command\n    pub command: String,\n    /// Command arguments\n    pub args: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Environment variables\n    pub env: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n    /// Server capabilities\n    pub capabilities: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n/// MCP servers configuration\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct McpServersConfig {\n    /// MCP servers\n    pub servers: HashMap&lt;String, EnhancedMcpServer&gt;,\n    /// Development mode specific servers\n    pub development: HashMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;,\n    /// Agent-specific server assignments\n    pub agent_servers: HashMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;,\n    /// Auto-start servers\n    pub auto_start: HashMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\n/// MCP integration manager with Windows 11 25H2 AI support\npub struct McpIntegrationManager {\n    /// Configuration path\n    config_path: PathBuf,\n    /// Active servers\n    active_servers: Arc&lt;Mutex&lt;HashMap&lt;String, EnhancedMcpServer&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n    /// Server processes\n    server_processes: Arc&lt;Mutex&lt;HashMap&lt;String, tokio::process::Child&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n    /// Windows AI integration options\n    #[cfg(all(target_os = \"windows\", feature = \"windows-ai\"))]\n    windows_ai_options: WindowsAiOptions,\n}\n\nimpl Default for McpIntegrationManager {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl McpIntegrationManager {\n    /// Create new MCP integration manager with Windows 11 25H2 AI support",

        "contents": "# Codex MCP Server Interface [experimental]\n\nThis document describes Codex’s experimental MCP server interface: a JSON‑RPC API that runs over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport to control a local Codex engine.\n\n- Status: experimental and subject to change without notice\n- Server binary: &#96;codex mcp-server&#96; (or &#96;codex-mcp-server&#96;)\n- Transport: standard MCP over stdio (JSON‑RPC 2.0, line‑delimited)\n\n## Overview\n\nCodex exposes a small set of MCP‑compatible methods to create and manage conversations, send user input, receive live events, and handle approval prompts. The types are defined in &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96; and re‑used by the MCP server implementation in &#96;mcp-server/&#96;.\n\nAt a glance:\n\n- Conversations\n  - &#96;newConversation&#96; → start a Codex session\n  - &#96;sendUserMessage&#96; / &#96;sendUserTurn&#96; → send user input into a conversation\n  - &#96;interruptConversation&#96; → stop the current turn\n  - &#96;listConversations&#96;, &#96;resumeConversation&#96;, &#96;archiveConversation&#96;\n- Configuration and info\n  - &#96;getUserSavedConfig&#96;, &#96;setDefaultModel&#96;, &#96;getUserAgent&#96;, &#96;userInfo&#96;\n  - &#96;model/list&#96; → enumerate available models and reasoning options\n- Auth\n  - &#96;account/read&#96;, &#96;account/login/start&#96;, &#96;account/login/cancel&#96;, &#96;account/logout&#96;, &#96;account/rateLimits/read&#96;\n  - notifications: &#96;account/login/completed&#96;, &#96;account/updated&#96;, &#96;account/rateLimits/updated&#96;\n- Utilities\n  - &#96;gitDiffToRemote&#96;, &#96;execOneOffCommand&#96;\n- Approvals (server → client requests)\n  - &#96;applyPatchApproval&#96;, &#96;execCommandApproval&#96;\n- Notifications (server → client)\n  - &#96;loginChatGptComplete&#96;, &#96;authStatusChange&#96;\n  - &#96;codex/event&#96; stream with agent events\n\nSee code for full type definitions and exact shapes: &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96;.\n\n## Starting the server\n\nRun Codex as an MCP server and connect an MCP client:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex mcp-server | your_mcp_client\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nFor a simple inspection UI, you can also try:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector codex mcp-server\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nUse the separate &#96;codex mcp&#96; subcommand to manage configured MCP server launchers in &#96;config.toml&#96;.\n\n## Conversations\n\nStart a new session with optional overrides:",

        "contents": "impl McpServer {\n    /// Create a new MCP server\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            clients: HashMap::new(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Register a client\n    pub fn register_client(&amp;mut self, agent_id: String, tx: mpsc::UnboundedSender&lt;McpMessage&gt;) {\n        info!(\"Registering MCP client: {}\", agent_id);\n        self.clients.insert(agent_id, tx);\n    }\n\n    /// Broadcast a message to all clients\n    pub fn broadcast(&amp;self, message: McpMessage) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        let mut errors = Vec::new();\n        for (agent_id, tx) in &amp;self.clients {\n            if let Err(e) = tx.send(message.clone()) {\n                errors.push((agent_id.clone(), e));\n            }\n        }\n\n        if !errors.is_empty() {\n            warn!(\"Failed to broadcast to {} clients\", errors.len());\n            for (agent_id, e) in errors {\n                error!(\"Failed to send to {}: {}\", agent_id, e);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Send a message to a specific client\n    pub fn send_to(&amp;self, agent_id: &amp;str, message: McpMessage) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        match self.clients.get(agent_id) {\n            Some(tx) =&gt; {\n                tx.send(message)\n                    .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(\"Failed to send to {}: {}\", agent_id, e))?;\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            None =&gt; {\n                anyhow::bail!(\"Client not found: {}\", agent_id);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for McpServer {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\n/// Check if Windows AI MCP is available\npub fn is_mcp_available() -&gt; bool {\n    // Windows 11 25H2 (Build 26100+) includes MCP support\n    // TODO: Implement actual Windows AI MCP API check when available\n    // For now, assume available on Windows 11 25H2+\n    #[cfg(target_os = \"windows\")]\n    {\n        // Check Windows build number (26100+)\n        true // Placeholder - implement actual check\n    }\n    #[cfg(not(target_os = \"windows\"))]\n    {\n        false\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "    fn process_event(&amp;mut self, event: Event) -&gt; CodexStatus {\n        let Event { id: _, msg } = event;\n        match msg {\n            EventMsg::Error(ErrorEvent { message, .. }) =&gt; {\n                let prefix = \"ERROR:\".style(self.red);\n                ts_msg!(self, \"{prefix} {message}\");\n            }\n            EventMsg::Warning(WarningEvent { message }) =&gt; {\n                ts_msg!(\n                    self,\n                    \"{} {message}\",\n                    \"warning:\".style(self.yellow).style(self.bold)\n                );\n            }\n            EventMsg::DeprecationNotice(DeprecationNoticeEvent { summary, details }) =&gt; {\n                ts_msg!(\n                    self,\n                    \"{} {summary}\",\n                    \"deprecated:\".style(self.magenta).style(self.bold)\n                );\n                if let Some(details) = details {\n                    ts_msg!(self, \"  {}\", details.style(self.dimmed));\n                }\n            }\n            EventMsg::BackgroundEvent(BackgroundEventEvent { message }) =&gt; {\n                ts_msg!(self, \"{}\", message.style(self.dimmed));\n            }\n            EventMsg::StreamError(StreamErrorEvent { message, .. }) =&gt; {\n                ts_msg!(self, \"{}\", message.style(self.dimmed));\n            }\n            EventMsg::TaskStarted(_) =&gt; {\n                // Ignore.\n            }\n            EventMsg::TaskComplete(TaskCompleteEvent { last_agent_message }) =&gt; {\n                let last_message = last_agent_message.as_deref();\n                if let Some(output_file) = self.last_message_path.as_deref() {\n                    handle_last_message(last_message, output_file);\n                }\n\n                self.final_message = last_agent_message;\n\n                return CodexStatus::InitiateShutdown;\n            }\n            EventMsg::ContextCompacted(_)\n            |",

        "contents": "    pub created_by: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl PlanBlock {\n    /// Create a new Plan from a goal\n    pub fn new(goal: String, title: String) -&gt; Self {\n        let now = Utc::now();\n        let id = format!(\n            \"{}_{}\",\n            now.format(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M-%SZ\"),\n            title.to_lowercase().replace(' ', \"-\")\n        );\n\n        Self {\n            id,\n            title,\n            goal,\n            assumptions: Vec::new(),\n            clarifying_questions: Vec::new(),\n            approach: String::new(),\n            mode: ExecutionMode::default(),\n            work_items: Vec::new(),\n            risks: Vec::new(),\n            eval: EvalCriteria::default(),\n            budget: Budget::default(),\n            rollback: String::new(),\n            artifacts: Vec::new(),\n            research: None,\n            quality_assurance: None,\n            state: super::state::PlanState::Drafting,\n            need_approval: true,\n            created_at: now,\n            updated_at: now,\n            created_by: None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Update the timestamp\n    pub fn touch(&amp;mut self) {\n        self.updated_at = Utc::now();\n    }\n\n    /// Check if Plan can be executed\n    pub fn can_execute(&amp;self) -&gt; bool {\n        matches!(self.state, super::state::PlanState::Approved { .. })\n    }\n\n    /// Add a work item\n    pub fn add_work_item(&amp;mut self, item: WorkItem) {\n        self.work_items.push(item);\n        self.touch();\n    }\n\n    /// Add a risk\n    pub fn add_risk(&amp;mut self, risk: Risk) {\n        self.risks.push(risk);\n        self.touch();\n    }\n\n    /// Set research results\n    pub fn set_research(&amp;mut self, research: ResearchBlock) {\n        self.research = Some(research);\n        self.touch();\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]",

        "contents": "    let mut error_seen = false;\n    while let Some(event) = rx.recv().await {\n        if let EventMsg::ElicitationRequest(ev) = &amp;event.msg {\n            // Automatically cancel elicitation requests in exec mode.\n            conversation\n                .submit(Op::ResolveElicitation {\n                    server_name: ev.server_name.clone(),\n                    request_id: ev.id.clone(),\n                    decision: ElicitationAction::Cancel,\n                })\n                .await?;\n        }\n        if matches!(event.msg, EventMsg::Error(_)) {\n            error_seen = true;\n        }\n        let shutdown: CodexStatus = event_processor.process_event(event);\n        match shutdown {\n            CodexStatus::Running =&gt; continue,\n            CodexStatus::InitiateShutdown =&gt; {\n                conversation.submit(Op::Shutdown).await?;\n            }\n            CodexStatus::Shutdown =&gt; {\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    event_processor.print_final_output();\n    if error_seen {\n        std::process::exit(1);\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nasync fn resolve_resume_path(\n    config: &amp;Config,\n    args: &amp;crate::cli::ResumeArgs,\n) -&gt;     {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\exec\\src\\event_processor_with_human_output.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 425,
            "column": 13
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 481,
            "column": 47
          }
        },
        "contents": "            EventMsg::PatchApplyEnd(PatchApplyEndEvent {\n                call_id,\n                stdout,\n                stderr,\n                success,\n                ..\n            }) =&gt; {\n                let patch_begin = self.call_id_to_patch.remove(&amp;call_id);\n\n                // Compute duration and summary label similar to exec commands.\n                let (duration, label) = if let Some(PatchApplyBegin {\n                    start_time,\n                    auto_approved,\n                }) = patch_begin\n                {\n                    (\n                        format!(\" in {}\", format_elapsed(start_time)),\n                        format!(\"apply_patch(auto_approved={auto_approved})\"),\n                    )\n                } else {\n                    (String::new(), format!(\"apply_patch('{call_id}')\"))\n                };\n\n                let (exit_code, output, title_style) = if success {\n                    (0, stdout, self.green)\n                } else {\n                    (1, stderr, self.red)\n                };\n\n                let title = format!(\"{label} exited {exit_code}{duration}:\");\n                ts_msg!(self, \"{}\", title.style(title_style));\n                for line in output.lines() {\n                    eprintln!(\"{}\", line.style(self.dimmed));\n                }\n            }\n            EventMsg::TurnDiff(TurnDiffEvent { unified_diff }) =&gt;         "contents": " {\n    let sound_path = PathBuf::from(r\"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav\");\n\n    if !sound_path.exists() {\n        debug!(\"Sound file not found: {}\", sound_path.display());\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Use Windows Media Player or PowerShell to play sound\n    #[cfg(target_os = \"windows\")]\n    {\n        let mut cmd = Command::new(\"powershell\");\n        cmd.arg(\"-Command\");\n        cmd.arg(format!(\n            \"(New-Object Media.SoundPlayer '{}').PlaySync()\",\n            sound_path.display()\n        ));\n\n        // Run in background (don't wait for completion)\n        let _ = cmd.spawn();\n    }\n\n    #[cfg(not(target_os = \"windows\"))]\n    {\n        // For non-Windows systems, try common audio players\n        let players = vec![\"aplay\", \"paplay\", \"afplay\"];\n        for player in players {\n            if Command::new(\"which\").arg(player).output().is_ok() {\n                let _ = Command::new(player).arg(&amp;sound_path).spawn();\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": " {",
            "lineNumber": 173

        "contents": "enum Subcommand {\n    /// Run Codex non-interactively.\n    #[clap(visible_alias = \"e\")]\n    Exec(ExecCli),\n\n    /// Manage login.\n    Login(LoginCommand),\n\n    /// Remove stored authentication credentials.\n    Logout(LogoutCommand),\n\n    /// [experimental] Run Codex as an MCP server and manage MCP servers.\n    Mcp(McpCli),\n\n    /// [experimental] Run the Codex MCP server (stdio transport).\n    McpServer,\n\n    /// [experimental] Run the app server.\n    AppServer,\n\n    /// Launch the Codex GUI web interface.\n    ///\n    /// Starts the GUI server and opens it in your default browser.\n    /// The GUI provides a modern web-based interface for managing agents,\n    /// monitoring system resources, and interacting with Codex features.\n    ///\n    /// Options:\n    ///   --port &lt;PORT&gt;         "contents": "use crate::cli::ReviewArgs;\nuse crate::event_processor::CodexStatus;\nuse crate::event_processor::EventProcessor;\nuse codex_core::default_client::set_default_originator;\nuse codex_core::find_conversation_path_by_id_str;\n\nenum InitialOperation {\n    UserTurn {\n        items: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt;,\n        output_schema: Option&lt;Value&gt;,\n    },\n    Review {\n        review_request: ReviewRequest,\n    },\n}\n\npub async fn run_main(cli: Cli, codex_linux_sandbox_exe: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    if let Err(err) = set_default_originator(\"codex_exec\".to_string()) {\n        tracing::warn!(?err, \"Failed to set codex exec originator override {err:?}\");\n    }\n\n    let Cli {\n        command,\n        images,\n        model: model_cli_arg,\n        oss,\n        oss_provider,\n        config_profile,\n        full_auto,\n        dangerously_bypass_approvals_and_sandbox,\n        cwd,\n        skip_git_repo_check,\n        add_dir,\n        color,\n        last_message_file,\n        json: json_mode,\n        sandbox_mode: sandbox_mode_cli_arg,\n        prompt,\n        output_schema: output_schema_path,\n        auto_threshold,\n        strategy,\n        skills,\n        mut config_overrides,\n    } = cli;\n\n    let (stdout_with_ansi, stderr_with_ansi) = match color {\n        cli::Color::Always =&gt; (true, true),\n        cli::Color::Never =&gt; (false, false),\n        cli::Color::Auto =&gt; (\n            supports_color::on_cached(Stream::Stdout).is_some(),\n            supports_color::on_cached(Stream::Stderr).is_some(),\n        ),\n    };\n\n    // Build fmt layer (existing logging) to compose with OTEL layer.\n    let default_level = \"error\";\n\n    // Build env_filter separately and attach via with_filter.\n    let env_filter = EnvFilter::try_from_default_env()\n        .or_else(|_| EnvFilter::try_new(default_level))\n        .unwrap_or_else(|_| EnvFilter::new(default_level));\n\n    let fmt_layer = tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n        .with_ansi(stderr_with_ansi)\n        .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n        .with_filter(env_filter);\n\n    let sandbox_mode = if full_auto {\n        Some(SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite)",

Manages automatic creation of implementation logs in _docs/ directory\n//! and provides startup log reading functionality with nanj-style responses\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Command;\nuse tracing::debug;\nuse tracing::error;\nuse tracing::info;\n\n/// Create an implementation log using Python script\npub async fn create_implementation_log(\n    feature_name: &amp;str,\n    task_description: &amp;str,\n    implementation_details: &amp;str,\n    worktree_name: Option&lt;&amp;str&gt;,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n    let script_path = find_implementation_logger_script()?;\n\n    let mut cmd = Command::new(\"py\");\n    cmd.arg(\"-3\");\n    cmd.arg(&amp;script_path);\n    cmd.arg(\"create\");\n    cmd.arg(feature_name);\n    cmd.arg(task_description);\n    cmd.arg(implementation_details);\n\n    if let Some(worktree) = worktree_name {\n        // Note: Python script will auto-detect worktree if not provided\n        // This is a placeholder for future enhancement\n        debug!(\"Worktree name: {}\", worktree);\n    }\n\n    let output = cmd\n        .output()\n        .context(\"Failed to execute implementation logger script\")?;\n\n    if !output.status.success() {\n        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stderr);\n        error!(\"Implementation logger script failed: {}\", stderr);\n        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n            \"Failed to create implementation log: {}\",\n            stderr\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // Parse JSON response to get log path\n    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stdout);\n    if let Ok(json) = serde_json::from_str::&lt;serde_json::Value&gt;(&amp;stdout) {\n        if let Some(path_str) = json.get(\"path\").and_then(|p| p.as_str()) {\n            return Ok(PathBuf::from(path_str));\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Fallback: construct path from feature name\n    let docs_dir = find_docs_directory()?;\n    let now = time::OffsetDateTime::now_local().unwrap_or_else(|_| time::OffsetDateTime::now_utc());\n    let date = format!(\n        \"{:04}-{:02}-{:02}\",\n        now.year(),\n        now.month()",

        "contents": "    }\n\n    fn print_final_output(&amp;mut self) {\n        if let Some(usage_info) = &amp;self.last_total_token_usage {\n            eprintln!(\n                \"{}\\n{}\",\n                \"tokens used\".style(self.magenta).style(self.italic),\n                format_with_separators(usage_info.total_token_usage.blended_total())\n            );\n        }\n\n        // If the user has not piped the final message to a file, they will see\n        // it twice: once written to stderr as part of the normal event\n        // processing, and once here on stdout. We print the token summary above\n        // to help break up the output visually in that case.\n        #[allow(clippy::print_stdout)]\n        if let Some(message) = &amp;self.final_message {\n            if message.ends_with('\\n') {\n                print!(\"{message}\");\n            } else {\n                println!(\"{message}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn escape_command(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt; String {\n    try_join(command.iter().map(String::as_str)).unwrap_or_else(|_| command.join(\" \"))\n}\n\nfn format_file_change(change: &amp;FileChange) -&gt; &amp;'static str {\n    match change {\n        FileChange::Add { .. } =&gt; \"A\",\n        FileChange::Delete { .. } =&gt; \"D\",\n        FileChange::Update {\n            move_path: Some(_), ..\n        } =&gt; \"R\",\n        FileChange::Update {\n            move_path: None, ..\n        } =&gt; \"M\",\n    }\n}\n\nfn format_mcp_invocation(invocation: &amp;McpInvocation) -&gt; String {\n    // Build fully-qualified tool name: server.tool\n    let fq_tool_name = format!(\"{}.{}\", invocation.server, invocation.tool);\n\n    // Format arguments as compact JSON so they fit on one line.\n    let args_str = invocation\n        .arguments\n        .as_ref()\n        .map(|v: &amp;serde_json::Value| serde_json::to_string(v).unwrap_or_else(|_| v.to_string()))\n        .unwrap_or_default();\n\n    if args_str.is_empty() {\n        format!(\"{fq_tool_name}()\")\n    } else {\n        format!(\"{fq_tool_name}({args_str})\")\n    }\n}",

{\n            prepend_config_flags(\n                &amp;mut exec_cli.config_overrides,\n                root_config_overrides.clone(),\n            );\n            codex_exec::run_main(exec_cli, codex_linux_sandbox_exe).await?;\n        }\n        Some(Subcommand::McpServer) =&gt; {\n            codex_mcp_server::run_main(codex_linux_sandbox_exe, root_config_overrides).await?;\n        }\n        Some(Subcommand::Mcp(mut mcp_cli)) =&gt; {\n            // Propagate any root-level config overrides (e.g. &#96;-c key=value&#96;).\n            prepend_config_flags(&amp;mut mcp_cli.config_overrides, root_config_overrides.clone());\n            mcp_cli.run().await?;\n        }\n        Some(Subcommand::AppServer) =&gt;         "contents": "(|_| time::OffsetDateTime::now_utc());\n    let date = format!(\n        \"{:04}-{:02}-{:02}\",\n        now.year(),\n        now.month() as u8,\n        now.day()\n    );\n    let safe_feature_name =\n        feature_name.replace(|c: char| !c.is_alphanumeric() &amp;&amp; c != '-' &amp;&amp; c != '_', \"_\");\n    let worktree = worktree_name.unwrap_or(\"main\");\n    let filename = format!(\"{}_{}{{{}}}.md\", date, safe_feature_name, worktree);\n    Ok(docs_dir.join(filename))\n}\n\n/// Load recent implementation logs\npub async fn load_recent_implementation_logs(limit: usize) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;ImplementationLog&gt;&gt; {\n    let script_path = find_implementation_logger_script()?;\n\n    let mut cmd = Command::new(\"py\");\n    cmd.arg(\"-3\");\n    cmd.arg(&amp;script_path);\n    cmd.arg(\"load\");\n    cmd.arg(limit.to_string());\n\n    let output = cmd\n        .output()\n        .context(\"Failed to execute implementation logger script\")?;\n\n    if !output.status.success() {\n        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stderr);\n        error!(\"Failed to load implementation logs: {}\", stderr);\n        return Ok(vec![]);\n    }\n\n    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stdout);\n    let logs: Vec&lt;ImplementationLog&gt; =\n        serde_json::from_str(&amp;stdout).context(\"Failed to parse implementation logs JSON\")?;\n\n    Ok(logs)\n}\n\n/// Generate nanj-style response from implementation logs\npub async fn generate_nanj_response() -&gt; Result&lt;String&gt; {\n    let script_path = find_implementation_logger_script()?;\n\n    let mut cmd = Command::new(\"py\");\n    cmd.arg(\"-3\");\n    cmd.arg(&amp;script_path);\n    cmd.arg(\"nanj\");\n\n    let output = cmd\n        .output()\n        .context(\"Failed to execute implementation logger script\")?;\n\n    if !output.status.success() {\n        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stderr);\n        error!(\"Failed to generate nanj response: {}\", stderr);\n        return Ok(\"実装ログの読み込みに失敗したで。\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stdout);\n    Ok(stdout.trim().to_string())\n}\n\n///",

The timestamp is styled with self.dimmed.\nmacro_rules! ts_msg {\n    ($self:ident, $($arg:tt)*) =&gt; {{\n        eprintln!($($arg)*);\n    }};\n}\n\nimpl EventProcessor for EventProcessorWithHumanOutput",

        "contents": "    pub created_by: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl PlanBlock {\n    /// Create a new Plan from a goal\n    pub fn new(goal: String, title: String) -&gt; Self {\n        let now = Utc::now();\n        let id = format!(\n            \"{}_{}\",\n            now.format(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M-%SZ\"),\n            title.to_lowercase().replace(' ', \"-\")\n        );\n\n        Self {\n            id,\n            title,\n            goal,\n            assumptions: Vec::new(),\n            clarifying_questions: Vec::new(),\n            approach: String::new(),\n            mode: ExecutionMode::default(),\n            work_items: Vec::new(),\n            risks: Vec::new(),\n            eval: EvalCriteria::default(),\n            budget: Budget::default(),\n            rollback: String::new(),\n            artifacts: Vec::new(),\n            research: None,\n            quality_assurance: None,\n            state: super::state::PlanState::Drafting,\n            need_approval: true,\n            created_at: now,\n            updated_at: now,\n            created_by: None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Update the timestamp\n    pub fn touch(&amp;mut self) {\n        self.updated_at = Utc::now();\n    }\n\n    /// Check if Plan can be executed\n    pub fn can_execute(&amp;self) -&gt; bool {\n        matches!(self.state, super::state::PlanState::Approved { .. })\n    }\n\n    /// Add a work item\n    pub fn add_work_item(&amp;mut self, item: WorkItem) {\n        self.work_items.push(item);\n        self.touch();\n    }\n\n    /// Add a risk\n    pub fn add_risk(&amp;mut self, risk: Risk) {\n        self.risks.push(risk);\n        self.touch();\n    }\n\n    /// Set research results\n    pub fn set_research(&amp;mut self, research: ResearchBlock) {\n        self.research = Some(research);\n        self.touch();\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]",

        "contents": "    fn test_orchestration_detection() {\n        let interpreter = AgentInterpreter::new();\n\n        let result = interpreter\n            .parse(\"AI orchestration with agent-alpha, agent-beta for refactor\")\n            .unwrap();\n\n        assert_eq!(result.agent_name, \"auto-orchestrator\");\n        assert_eq!(\n            result.parameters.get(\"agents\").unwrap(),\n            \"agent-alpha, agent-beta\"\n        );\n        assert_eq!(result.action, AgentAction::AutoOrchestrate);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_webhook_detection() {\n        let interpreter = AgentInterpreter::new();\n\n        let result = interpreter\n            .parse(\"Send Slack webhook to #alerts: \\\"Deploy succeeded\\\"\")\n            .unwrap();\n\n        assert_eq!(result.agent_name, \"slack-webhook\");\n        assert_eq!(result.parameters.get(\"channel\").unwrap(), \"#alerts\");\n        assert_eq!(\n            result.action,\n            AgentAction::TriggerWebhook {\n                service: WebhookServiceKind::Slack\n            }\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_mcp_detection() {\n        let interpreter = AgentInterpreter::new();\n\n        let result = interpreter\n            .parse(\"Show me the MCP tools configured for this project\")\n            .unwrap();\n\n        assert_eq!(result.agent_name, \"mcp\");\n        assert_eq!(result.action, AgentAction::ListMcpTools);\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "    Ok(stdout.trim().to_string())\n}\n\n/// Find the implementation logger Python script\nfn find_implementation_logger_script() -&gt; Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n    // Try to find script in scripts/ directory relative to workspace root\n    let current_dir = std::env::current_dir()?;\n\n    // Try multiple possible locations\n    let possible_paths = vec![\n        current_dir.join(\"scripts\").join(\"implementation_logger.py\"),\n        current_dir\n            .join(\"..\")\n            .join(\"scripts\")\n            .join(\"implementation_logger.py\"),\n        PathBuf::from(\"scripts\").join(\"implementation_logger.py\"),\n    ];\n\n    for path in possible_paths {\n        if path.exists() {\n            return Ok(path);\n        }\n    }\n\n    Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n        \"Could not find implementation_logger.py script\"\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Find the _docs directory\nfn find_docs_directory() -&gt; Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n    let current_dir = std::env::current_dir()?;\n    let docs_dir = current_dir.join(\"_docs\");\n\n    if !docs_dir.exists() {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&amp;docs_dir).context(\"Failed to create _docs directory\")?;\n    }\n\n    Ok(docs_dir)\n}\n\n/// Implementation log structure\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]\npub struct ImplementationLog {\n    pub file: String,\n    pub date: String,\n    pub feature: String,\n    pub worktree: String,\n    pub content: String,\n}\n\n/// Play sound file on plan/agent completion\npub async fn play_completion_sound() -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    let sound_path = PathBuf::from(r\"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav\");\n\n    if !sound_path.exists() {\n        debug!",

        "contents": "async function onPing() {\n  setStatus(\"Connecting...\");\n  try {\n    const response = await sendNative(makeNativeMessage(\"ping\", {}, {}));\n    if (!response || !response.ok) {\n      setStatus(\"Disconnected\", true);\n      const errorMsg = response?.error || response?.originalError || \"Failed to connect to native host\";\n      setOutput({ error: errorMsg, hint: \"Run: cargo build -p codex-chrome-host --release\" });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setStatus(\"Connected\");\n    setOutput(response.response || { message: \"pong\" });\n  } catch (error) {\n    setStatus(\"Error\", true);\n    setOutput({ \n      error: error.message || String(error),\n      hint: \"Ensure codex-chrome-host is installed and registered with Chrome\"\n    });\n  }\n}\n\nasync function onResearch() {\n  const query = queryEl.value.trim();\n}",

        "contents": "(request, sender, sendResponse) =&gt; {\n\n\n  if (request.type === \"network.get_logs.request\") {\n    (async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        let logs = networkLogs.slice();\n        \n        // Filter by URL pattern if specified\n        if (request.filter) {\n          logs = logs.filter(log =&gt; log.url.includes(request.filter));\n        }\n        \n        // Limit results\n        const limit = request.limit || 50;\n        logs = logs.slice(-limit);\n        \n        const result = { logs };\n        \n        // Send result to native host if needed\n        if (request.sendToNative) {\n          const nativeMessage = {\n            version: \"1.0\",\n            id: request.id || crypto.randomUUID(),\n            type: \"network.get_logs.response\",\n            origin: request.origin || {},\n            payload: {\n              success: true,\n              data: result\n            }\n          };\n          await sendNativeMessage(nativeMessage);\n        }\n        sendResponse({ ok: true, result });\n      } catch (error) {\n        sendResponse({ ok: false, error: error.message || String(error) });\n      }\n    })();\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"dom.read\") {\n    handleDomRead(request)\n      .then((result) =&gt;         "contents": "async function onParseNl() {\n  const utterance = nlInputEl.value.trim();\n  if (!utterance) {\n    setNotice(nlNoticeEl, \"Enter an instruction.\", true);\n    return;\n  }\n\n  setNotice(nlNoticeEl, \"\");\n  nlExecuteBtn.disabled = true;\n  pendingIntent = null;\n\n  setStatus(\"Parsing...\");\n  let tab;\n  try {\n    tab = await getActiveTab();\n  } catch (err) {\n    setStatus(\"Error\", true);\n    setNotice(nlNoticeEl, err.message || String(err), true);\n    return;\n  }\n\n  const message = makeNativeMessage(\n    \"nl_command.request\",\n    {\n      utterance,\n      constraints: {\n        allowed_intents: [\n          \"click\",\n          \"type\",\n          \"scroll\",\n          \"wait_for\",\n          \"read_dom\",\n          \"post_social\",\n          \"login_start\",\n          \"shop_add_to_cart\",\n          \"post_article\",\n          \"shop_prepare_purchase\"\n        ],\n        require_confirmation_for: [\n          \"post_social\",\n          \"login_start\",\n          \"shop_add_to_cart\",\n          \"post_article\",\n          \"shop_prepare_purchase\"\n        ]\n      }\n    },\n    {\n      tab_id: tab.id,\n      url: tab.url,\n      frame_id: 0\n    }\n  );\n\n  const response = await sendNative(message);\n  if (!response || !response.ok || !response.response?.success) {\n    setStatus(\"Error\", true);\n    setNotice(\n      nlNoticeEl,\n      response?.response?.error || response?.error || \"Parse failed\",\n      true\n    );\n    return;\n  }\n\n  const data = response.response.data || {};\n  if (data.success === false) {\n    setStatus(\"Error\", true);\n    setNotice(nlNoticeEl, data.error || \"Parse failed\", true);\n    setOutput(data);\n    return;\n  }\n  const intent = data.intent || data.data?.intent;\n  const warnings = data.warnings || data.data?.warnings || [];\n  if (!intent) {\n    setStatus(\"Error\", true);\n    setNotice(nlNoticeEl, \"No intent returned.\", true);\n    setOutput(data);\n    return;\n  }\n  pendingIntent = intent;\n\n  const requiresConfirmation = Boolean(intent.requires_confirmation);\n  nlExecuteBtn.textContent =         "contents": "async function onResearch() {\n  const query = queryEl.value.trim();\n  if (!query) {\n    setOutput(\"Enter a research query.\");\n    return;\n  }\n\n  setStatus(\"Running...\");\n  const depth = Number(depthEl.value) || 2;\n  try {\n    const response = await sendNative(\n      makeNativeMessage(\n        \"deep_research.request\",\n        {\n          query,\n          options: { depth }\n        },\n        {}\n      )\n    );\n\n    if (!response || !response.ok || !response.response?.success) {\n      setStatus(\"Error\", true);\n      const errorMsg = response?.response?.error || response?.error || response?.originalError || \"Research failed\";\n      setOutput({ error: errorMsg });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setStatus(\"Done\");\n    setOutput(response.response.data || {});\n  } catch (error) {\n    setStatus(\"Error\", true);\n    setOutput({ \n      error: error.message || String(error),\n      hint: \"Check native host connection\"\n    });\n  }\n}\n\nasync function onReadDom() {\n  setStatus(\"Reading...\");\n}",

        "contents": "function sendMessageToTab(tabId, message) {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n    chrome.tabs.sendMessage(tabId, message, (response) =&gt; {\n      if (chrome.runtime.lastError) {\n        reject(new Error(chrome.runtime.lastError.message));\n        return;\n      }\n      resolve(response);\n    });\n  });\n}\n\nasync function handleDomRead(request) {\n  const tab = await queryActiveTab();\n}",

        "contents": "async function handleActionExecute(request) {\n  const highRisk = new Set([\n    \"post_social\",\n    \"post_article\",\n    \"login_start\",\n    \"shop_add_to_cart\",\n    \"shop_prepare_purchase\",\n    \"eval\"\n  ]);\n  const actions = Array.isArray(request.actions) ? request.actions : [];\n  const needsConfirmation = actions.some((action) =&gt; highRisk.has(action.type));\n  if (needsConfirmation &amp;&amp; !request.confirmed) {\n    throw new Error(\"Confirmation required for high-risk actions\");\n  }\n  const tab = await queryActiveTab();\n  ensureAllowedDomains(actions, tab.url || \"\");\n  await injectContentScript(tab.id);\n  return await sendMessageToTab(tab.id, {\n    type: \"action.execute\",\n    actions\n  });\n}\n\nasync function handleConsoleSubscribe() {\n  const tab = await queryActiveTab();\n}",

Native Messaging Hostが拡張機能にリクエストを転送（拡張機能が接続している場合）\n5. 拡張機能が処理して結果を返す\n\n### オプション2: CLIが拡張機能と直接通信\n\n1. 拡張機能がローカルHTTPサーバーまたはNamed Pipeを起動\n2. CLIが結果を読み取る\n\n**推奨アプローチ**: オプション1を採用し、拡張機能がNative Messaging Hostに接続して、CLIからのリクエストを処理できるようにします。\n\n## 実装ファイル\n\n### 1. &#96;run_dom&#96;と&#96;run_network&#96;と同様に実装\n   - Native Messaging Hostと通信\n\n2. **エラーハンドリングの改善**\n   - タイムアウト処理\n   - より詳細なエラーメッセージ\n\n### Phase 2: 拡張機能との連携\n\n3. **拡張機能がNative Messaging Hostに接続する機能**\n   - CLIが起動したNative Messaging Hostに拡張機能が接続できるようにする\n   - または、拡張機能が常にNative Messaging Hostに接続している状態を維持\n\n4. **リクエストの転送機能**\n   - Native Messaging Hostが拡張機能にリクエストを転送\n   - 拡張機能が処理して結果を返す\n\n### Phase 3: 統合とテスト\n\n5. **統合テスト**\n   - エンドツーエンドテスト\n   - エラーハンドリングのテスト\n\n6. **ドキュメント更新**\n   - 使用方法の更新\n   - アーキテクチャの説明\n\n## 技術詳細\n\n### CLIからNative Messaging Hostを呼び出す方法\n\n現在の実装では、CLIがNative Messaging Hostを起動して直接通信しています。しかし、DOM読み取り、コンソールログ取得、ネットワークログ取得は、実際には拡張機能のcontent scriptやbackground scriptが実行する必要があります。\n\n### 拡張機能との連携\n\nNative Messaging Hostは通常、拡張機能から呼び出されるものです。CLIから直接呼び出す場合、拡張機能がそれを検知して処理する仕組みが必要です。\n\n**実装方針**: \n- CLIがNative Messaging Hostを起動\n- 拡張機能が定期的にNative Messaging Hostに接続を試みる（または、拡張機能が常に接続している状態を維持）\n- CLIがリクエストを送信\n- Native Messaging Hostが拡張機能にリクエストを転送\n- 拡張機能が処理して結果を返す\n\nただし、この実装は複雑なため、より実用的なアプローチとして、CLIが直接拡張機能と通信する方法を実装することを検討します。\n\n## 実装の詳細\n\n### &#96;run_console&#96;の実装\n\n&#96;run_dom&#96;と&#96;run_network&#96;と同様に、Native Messaging Hostと通信する実装を追加します。\n\n### エラーハンドリング\n\n- タイムアウト処理（リクエストが一定時間内に返らない場合）\n- より詳細なエラーメッセージ\n- Native Messaging Hostの起動失敗時の処理\n\n### 拡張機能との連携\n\n拡張機能がNative Messaging Hostに接続し、CLIからのリクエストを処理できるようにします。ただし、Native Messaging Hostは拡張機能から呼び出されるため、CLIが起動したNative Messaging Hostに拡張機能が接続するには、特別な仕組みが必要です。\n\n**実用的なアプローチ**: \n- CLIがNative Messaging Hostを起動して待機\n- 拡張機能がNative Messaging Hostに接続（通常の動作）\n- CLIがリクエストを送信\n- Native Messaging Hostが拡張機能にリクエストを転送（拡張機能が接続している場合）\n- 拡張機能が処理して結果を返す\n\nただし、この実装は複雑なため、まずは&#96;run_console&#96;の実装とエラーハンドリングの改善を行い、拡張機能との連携は後で実装することも検討します。",

        "contents": "chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((request, sender, sendResponse) =&gt; {\n  if (!request || !request.type) {\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"dom.read\") {\n    try {\n      const result = readDom(request.selector, request.maxChars);\n      sendResponse({ ok: true, result });\n    } catch (err) {\n      sendResponse({ ok: false, error: err.message || String(err) });\n    }\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"action.execute\") {\n    executeActions(request.actions)\n      .then((result) =&gt; {\n        sendResponse(result);\n      })\n      .catch((error) =&gt; {\n        sendResponse({ ok: false, error: error.message || String(error) });\n      });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"console.subscribe\") {\n    installConsoleHook();\n    sendResponse({ ok: true });\n    return;\n  }\n});",

        "contents": "(request, sender, sendResponse) =&gt; {\n\n\n  if (request.type === \"network.get_logs.request\") {\n    (async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        let logs = networkLogs.slice();\n        \n        // Filter by URL pattern if specified\n        if (request.filter) {\n          logs = logs.filter(log =&gt; log.url.includes(request.filter));\n        }\n        \n        // Limit results\n        const limit = request.limit || 50;\n        logs = logs.slice(-limit);\n        \n        const result = { logs };\n        \n        // Send result to native host if needed\n        if (request.sendToNative) {\n          const nativeMessage = {\n            version: \"1.0\",\n            id: request.id || crypto.randomUUID(),\n            type: \"network.get_logs.response\",\n            origin: request.origin || {},\n            payload: {\n              success: true,\n              data: result\n            }\n          };\n          await sendNativeMessage(nativeMessage);\n        }\n        sendResponse({ ok: true, result });\n      } catch (error) {\n        sendResponse({ ok: false, error: error.message || String(error) });\n      }\n    })();\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"dom.read\") {\n    handleDomRead(request)\n      .then((result) =&gt;         "contents": "const HOST_NAME = \"com.codex.chrome\";\nconst CONTENT_SCRIPT_PATH = \"content/content.js\";\nconst MAX_LOGS = 200;\nconst ACTION_DOMAIN_ALLOWLIST = {\n  post_social: [\"x.com\", \"twitter.com\"],\n  post_article: [\"note.com\", \"qiita.com\", \"zenn.dev\"],\n  shop_add_to_cart: [\"amazon.com\", \"amazon.co.jp\"],\n  shop_prepare_purchase: [\"mercari.com\", \"mercari.jp\", \"auctions.yahoo.co.jp\"]\n};\nconst OPTIONAL_HOST_PERMISSIONS = [\n  \"*://*.x.com/*\",\n  \"*://*.twitter.com/*\",\n  \"*://*.note.com/*\",\n  \"*://*.qiita.com/*\",\n  \"*://*.zenn.dev/*\",\n  \"*://*.amazon.com/*\",\n  \"*://*.amazon.co.jp/*\",\n  \"*://*.mercari.com/*\",\n  \"*://*.mercari.jp/*\",\n  \"*://auctions.yahoo.co.jp/*\"\n];\n\nlet nativePort = null;\nconst nativeQueue = [];\nconst consoleLogs = [];\nconst networkLogs = [];\nconst networkSubscriptions = new Map();\nlet networkListenersReady = false;\n\nfunction pushLog(buffer, entry) {\n  buffer.push(entry);\n  if (buffer.length &gt; MAX_LOGS) {\n    buffer.shift();\n  }\n}\n\nfunction connectNative() {\n  if (nativePort) {\n    return nativePort;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async function onResearch() {\n  const query = queryEl.value.trim();\n  if (!query) {\n    setOutput(\"Enter a research query.\");\n    return;\n  }\n\n  setStatus(\"Running...\");\n  const depth = Number(depthEl.value) || 2;\n  try {\n    const response = await sendNative(\n      makeNativeMessage(\n        \"deep_research.request\",\n        {\n          query,\n          options: { depth }\n        },\n        {}\n      )\n    );\n\n    if (!response || !response.ok || !response.response?.success) {\n      setStatus(\"Error\", true);\n      const errorMsg = response?.response?.error || response?.error || response?.originalError || \"Research failed\";\n      setOutput({ error: errorMsg });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setStatus(\"Done\");\n    setOutput(response.response.data || {});\n  } catch (error) {\n    setStatus(\"Error\", true);\n    setOutput({ \n      error: error.message || String(error),\n      hint: \"Check native host connection\"\n    });\n  }\n}\n\nasync function onReadDom() {\n  setStatus(\"Reading...\");\n}",

        "contents": "async function runAction(action) {\n  switch (action.type) {\n    case \"click\":\n      await clickTarget(action.target);\n      return { ok: true };\n    case \"type\":\n      await typeIntoTarget(action.target, action.text || \"\", action.enter || false);\n      return { ok: true };\n    case \"scroll\":\n      await scrollByAmount(action);\n      return { ok: true };\n    case \"wait_for\":\n      await waitForTarget(action.target, action.timeoutMs || 8000);\n      return { ok: true };\n    case \"read_dom\":\n      return { ok: true, result: readDom(action.selector, action.maxChars) };\n    case \"eval\": {\n      const fn = new Function(action.code || \"\");\n      const result = fn();\n      return { ok: true, result };\n    }\n    case \"post_article\":\n      return await runPostArticle(action);\n    case \"post_social\":\n      if ((action.platform || \"\").toLowerCase() === \"x\") {\n        await runPostToX(action.text || \"\");\n        return { ok: true };\n      }\n      throw new Error(\"Unsupported social platform\");\n    case \"login_start\":\n      await runLoginClick();\n      return { ok: true };\n    case \"shop_add_to_cart\":\n      await runAmazonAddToCart(action.productName || \"\");\n      return { ok: true };\n    case \"shop_prepare_purchase\": {\n      const platform = normalizeText(action.platform);\n      if (platform === \"mercari\") {\n        await runMercariPreparePurchase(action.productName || \"\");\n        return { ok: true };\n      }\n      if (platform === \"yahoo_auctions\") {\n        await runYahooAuctionPreparePurchase(action.productName || \"\");\n        return { ok: true };\n      }\n      throw new Error(\"Unsupported shopping platform\");\n    }\n    default:\n      throw new Error(&#96;Unsupported action: ${action.type}&#96;);\n  }\n}\n\nasync function executeActions(actions) {\n  if (!Array.isArray(actions))\n}",

        "contents": "(request, sender, sendResponse) =&gt; {\n\n(error) =&gt; {\n\n      });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"console.get_logs\") {\n    sendResponse({ ok: true, logs: consoleLogs.slice() });\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"network.subscribe\") {\n    (async () =&gt; {\n      const granted = await requestNetworkPermissions();\n      if (!granted) {\n        sendResponse({ ok: false, error: \"Permission denied\" });\n        return;\n      }\n\n      ensureNetworkListeners();\n      const tab = await queryActiveTab();\n      networkSubscriptions.set(tab.id, { filter: request.filter || null });\n      sendResponse({ ok: true, message: \"Subscribed\" });\n    })().catch((error) =&gt; {\n      sendResponse({ ok: false, error: error.message || String(error) });\n    });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"network.unsubscribe\") {\n    (async () =&gt; {\n      const tab = await queryActiveTab();\n      networkSubscriptions.delete(tab.id);\n      sendResponse({ ok: true, message: \"Unsubscribed\" });\n    })().catch((error) =&gt; {\n      sendResponse({ ok: false, error: error.message || String(error) });\n    });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"network.get_logs\") {\n    sendResponse({ ok: true, logs: networkLogs.slice() });\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"tab.active\") {\n    queryActiveTab()\n      .then((tab) =&gt; {\n        sendResponse({ ok: true, tab });\n      })\n      .catch((error) =&gt; {\n        sendResponse({ ok: false, error: error.message || String(error) });\n      });\n    return true;\n  }\n});",

        "contents": "(request, sender, sendResponse) =&gt; {\n\n\n  if (request.type === \"console.get_logs.request\") {\n    (async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        let logs = consoleLogs.slice();\n        \n        // Filter by level if specified\n        if (request.level) {\n          logs = logs.filter(log =&gt; log.level === request.level);\n        }\n        \n        // Filter by message content if specified\n        if (request.filter) {\n          logs = logs.filter(log =&gt; log.message.includes(request.filter));\n        }\n        \n        // Limit results\n        const limit = request.limit || 50;\n        logs = logs.slice(-limit);\n        \n        const result = { logs };\n        \n        // Send result to native host if needed\n        if (request.sendToNative) {\n          const nativeMessage = {\n            version: \"1.0\",\n            id: request.id || crypto.randomUUID(),\n            type: \"console.get_logs.response\",\n            origin: request.origin || {},\n            payload: {\n              success: true,\n              data: result\n            }\n          };\n          await sendNativeMessage(nativeMessage);\n        }\n        sendResponse({ ok: true, result });\n      } catch (error) {\n        sendResponse({ ok: false, error: error.message || String(error) });\n      }\n    })();\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"network.get_logs.request\")\n}",

        "contents": "export default function TimelineSlider({\n  minDate,\n  maxDate,\n  currentDate,\n  onDateChange,\n  commits,\n}: TimelineSliderProps) {\n  const { camera } = useThree()\n  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false)\n  const [playbackSpeed, setPlaybackSpeed] = useState(1)\n  const sliderRef = useState(() =&gt; document.createElement('input'))[0]\n\n  // Calculate date range\n  const dateRange = maxDate - minDate\n  const progress = ((currentDate - minDate) / dateRange) * 100\n\n  // Format date for display\n  const formatDate = (timestamp: number) =&gt; {\n    const date = new Date(timestamp)\n    return date.toLocaleDateString('ja-JP', {\n      year: 'numeric',\n      month: 'short',\n      day: 'numeric',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Handle slider change\n  const handleSliderChange = useCallback(\n    (event: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt; {\n      const value = parseFloat(event.target.value)\n      const newDate = minDate + (value / 100) * dateRange\n      onDateChange(newDate)\n    },\n    [minDate, dateRange, onDateChange]\n  )\n\n  // Playback animation\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (!isPlaying) return\n\n    let animationFrame: number\n    let lastTime = performance.now()\n\n    const animate = (currentTime: number) =&gt; {\n      const delta = (currentTime - lastTime) / 1000\n      lastTime = currentTime\n\n      // Calculate new date\n      const increment = (delta * playbackSpeed * dateRange) / 60\n      const newDate = Math.min(maxDate, currentDate + increment)\n\n      if (newDate &gt;= maxDate) {\n        setIsPlaying(false)\n      }\n\n      onDateChange(newDate)\n      animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animate)\n    }\n\n    animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animate)\n\n    return () =&gt; cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame)\n  }, [isPlaying, currentDate, dateRange, maxDate, onDateChange, playbackSpeed])\n\n  // Get commit count at current time\n  const getCommitCount = () =&gt; {\n    return commits.filter(\n      (c) =&gt; new Date(c.timestamp).getTime() &lt;= currentDate\n    ).length\n  }\n\n  return (\n}",

        "contents": "    #[wasm_bindgen]\n    pub fn create_conversation(&amp;mut self, model: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;JsValue, JsValue&gt; {\n        let id = format!(\"conv_{}\", js_sys::Date::now() as u64);\n        let conversation = ConversationData {\n            id: id.clone(),\n            messages: vec![],\n            model: model.to_string(),\n            created_at: js_sys::Date::now().to_string(),\n            updated_at: js_sys::Date::now().to_string(),\n        };\n\n        self.conversations.insert(id.clone(), conversation.clone());\n        self.current_conversation = Some(id);\n\n        console_log!(\"Created conversation: {}\", conversation.id);\n        Ok(serde_wasm_bindgen::to_value(&amp;conversation)?)\n    }\n\n    #[wasm_bindgen]\n    pub fn send_message(&amp;mut self, content: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;JsValue, JsValue&gt; {\n        let conv_id = self.current_conversation.as_ref()\n            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str(\"No active conversation\"))?;\n\n        let conversation = self.conversations.get_mut(conv_id)\n            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str(\"Conversation not found\"))?;\n\n        let user_message = ConversationMessage {\n            role: \"user\".to_string(),\n            content: content.to_string(),\n            timestamp: js_sys::Date::now().to_string(),\n        };\n\n        conversation.messages.push(user_message.clone());\n\n        // Simulate AI response\n        let ai_response = ConversationMessage {\n            role: \"assistant\".to_string(),\n            content: format!(\"こんにちは！ {} についてお手伝いしますね。\", content),\n            timestamp: js_sys::Date::now().to_string(),\n        };\n\n        conversation.messages.push(ai_response.clone());\n        conversation.updated_at = js_sys::Date::now().to_string();\n\n        console_log!(\"Sent message to conversation: {}\", conv_id);\n        Ok(serde_wasm_bindgen::to_value(&amp;conversation.messages)?)\n    }\n\n    #[wasm_bindgen]\n    pub fn get_conversations(&amp;self) -&gt;         "contents": "async fn send_message(\n    State(state): State&lt;AppState&gt;,\n    Path(conversation_id): Path&lt;String&gt;,\n    Json(request): Json&lt;SendMessageRequest&gt;,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;Json&lt;Message&gt;, GuiError&gt; {\n    let message = Message {\n        id: Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),\n        role: request.role.unwrap_or_else(|| \"user\".to_string()),\n        content: request.content.clone(),\n        timestamp: Utc::now(),\n    };\n\n    // Add message to conversation\n    let mut messages = state.messages.write().await;\n    let conversation_messages = messages\n        .entry(conversation_id.clone())\n        .or_insert_with(Vec::new);\n    conversation_messages.push(message.clone());\n\n    // Update conversation metadata\n    let mut conversations = state.conversations.write().await;\n    if let Some(conversation) = conversations.iter_mut().find(|c| c.id == conversation_id) {\n        conversation.last_activity = Utc::now();\n        conversation.message_count += 1;\n    }\n\n    Ok(Json(message))\n}\n\nasync fn get_current_user(State(state): State&lt;AppState&gt;) -&gt; Json&lt;Option&lt;User&gt;&gt; {\n    let user = state.current_user.read().await.clone();\n\n    // If no user is set, create a default user\n    if user.is_none() {\n        let default_user = User {\n            id: \"default-user\".to_string(),\n            name: \"Codex User\".to_string(),\n            email: \"user@codex.local\".to_string(),\n            avatar_url: None,\n        };\n\n        let mut current_user = state.current_user.write().await;\n        *current_user = Some(default_user.clone());\n        return Json(Some(default_user));\n    }\n\n    Json(user)\n}",

        "contents": "const args = parseArgs(process.argv);\n\nif (args.help || args.h) {\n  console.log(usage());\n  process.exit(0);\n}\n\nconst required = ['worktree', 'functionality', 'verification', 'agent', 'ai'];\nconst missing = required.filter((key) =&gt; !args[key]);\nif (missing.length &gt; 0) {\n  console.error(&#96;Missing required arguments: ${missing.join(', ')}&#96;);\n  console.log(usage());\n  process.exit(1);\n}\n\nconst now = new Date();\nconst isoTimestamp = now.toISOString();\nconst datePart = isoTimestamp.slice(0, 10);\nconst timePart = isoTimestamp.slice(11, 19);\nconst timezone = process.env.TZ || 'UTC';\nconst localeTimestamp = now.toLocaleString('ja-JP', { timeZone: timezone });\n\nconst worktreeSlug = sanitize(args.worktree, path.basename(repoRoot));\nlet fileName = &#96;${datePart}-${worktreeSlug}実装ログ.md&#96;;\nconst logDir = path.join(repoRoot, '_doc');\nif (!fs.existsSync(logDir)) {\n  fs.mkdirSync(logDir, { recursive: true });\n}\nlet filePath = path.join(logDir, fileName);\nif (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {\n  const suffix = timePart.replace(/:/g, '');\n  fileName = &#96;${datePart}-${worktreeSlug}-${suffix}実装ログ.md&#96;;\n  filePath = path.join(logDir, fileName);\n}\n\nconst branch = run('git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD');\nconst gitStatus = run('git status --short');\nconst prompt = args.prompt || 'N/A';\nconst tests = args.tests || '未実行 / 別所に記載';\nconst qcSummary = args.qc || '未記入';\nconst statsSummary = args.stats || '未記入';\nconst optimizationNotes = args.optimization || '未記入';\nconst decision = args.decision || '未記入';\nconst notes = args.notes || 'N/A';\n\nconst content = &#96;# 実装ログ (\n&#96;;",

        "contents": "/// Evidence-based research support with citation management\n///\n/// Provides standardized Evidence structure for tracking sources,\n/// quotes, confidence scores, and reproducibility logging.\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher;\nuse std::hash::Hash;\nuse std::hash::Hasher;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\n\n/// Standard evidence structure for research citations\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Evidence {\n    /// Title of the source\n    pub title: String,\n    /// URL of the source\n    pub url: String,\n    /// Publication date (ISO 8601 format, optional)\n    pub published: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Relevant quote or excerpt\n    pub quote: String,\n    /// Confidence score (0.0-1.0)\n    pub confidence: f64,\n}\n\nimpl Evidence {\n    /// Create a new evidence entry\n    pub fn new(\n        title: impl Into&lt;String&gt;,\n        url: impl Into&lt;String&gt;,\n        quote: impl Into&lt;String&gt;,\n        confidence: f64,\n    ) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            title: title.into(),\n            url: url.into(),\n            published: None,\n            quote: quote.into(),\n            confidence: confidence.clamp(0.0, 1.0),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Set publication date\n    pub fn with_published_date(mut self, date: impl Into&lt;String&gt;) -&gt; Self {\n        self.published = Some(date.into());\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// Check if this evidence is from a recent source (within days)\n    pub fn is_recent(&amp;self, _days: u32) -&gt; bool {\n        if let Some(ref published) = self.published {\n            // Simple date comparison using string matching\n            // For now, just check if it's from 2024 or 2025\n            published.contains(\"2024\") || published.contains(\"2025\")\n        } else {\n            false\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Research log for reproducibility\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ResearchLog {\n    /// Original search query\n    pub query: String,",

        "contents": "/// Evidence-based research support with citation management\n///\n/// Provides standardized Evidence structure for tracking sources,\n/// quotes, confidence scores, and reproducibility logging.\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher;\nuse std::hash::Hash;\nuse std::hash::Hasher;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\n\n/// Standard evidence structure for research citations\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Evidence {\n    /// Title of the source\n    pub title: String,\n    /// URL of the source\n    pub url: String,\n    /// Publication date (ISO 8601 format, optional)\n    pub published: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Relevant quote or excerpt\n    pub quote: String,\n    /// Confidence score (0.0-1.0)\n    pub confidence: f64,\n}\n\nimpl Evidence {\n    /// Create a new evidence entry\n    pub fn new(\n        title: impl Into&lt;String&gt;,\n        url: impl Into&lt;String&gt;,\n        quote: impl Into&lt;String&gt;,\n        confidence: f64,\n    ) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            title: title.into(),\n            url: url.into(),\n            published: None,\n            quote: quote.into(),\n            confidence: confidence.clamp(0.0, 1.0),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Set publication date\n    pub fn with_published_date(mut self, date: impl Into&lt;String&gt;) -&gt; Self {\n        self.published = Some(date.into());\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// Check if this evidence is from a recent source (within days)\n    pub fn is_recent(&amp;self, _days: u32) -&gt; bool {\n        if let Some(ref published) = self.published {\n            // Simple date comparison using string matching\n            // For now, just check if it's from 2024 or 2025\n            published.contains(\"2024\") || published.contains(\"2025\")\n        } else {\n            false\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Research log for reproducibility\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ResearchLog {\n    /// Original search query\n    pub query: String,",

        "contents": "impl AuditEvent {\n    /// Create a new audit event with generated ID and timestamp\n    pub fn new(actor_id: String, event_type: AuditEventType) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),\n            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),\n            session_id: None,\n            actor_id,\n            event_type,\n            metadata: HashMap::new(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Set session ID\n    pub fn with_session(mut self, session_id: String) -&gt; Self {\n        self.session_id = Some(session_id);\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// Add metadata\n    pub fn with_metadata(mut self, key: String, value: String) -&gt; Self {\n        self.metadata.insert(key, value);\n        self\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_audit_event_creation() {\n        let event = AuditEvent::new(\n            \"test-agent\".to_string(),\n            AuditEventType::AgentExecution(AgentExecutionEvent {\n                agent_name: \"test-agent\".to_string(),\n                status: ExecutionStatus::Started,\n                goal: \"Test goal\".to_string(),\n                start_time: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),\n                end_time: None,\n                duration_secs: None,\n                tokens_used: 0,\n                artifacts: vec![],\n                error: None,\n            }),\n        );\n\n        assert!(!event.id.is_empty());\n        assert!(!event.timestamp.is_empty());\n        assert_eq!(event.actor_id, \"test-agent\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_event_serialization() {\n        let event =",

Use &#96;-&#96; instead of &#96;:&#96; for\n    // compatibility with filesystems that do not allow colons in filenames.\n    let format: &amp;[FormatItem] =\n        format_description!(\"[year]-[month]-[day]T[hour]-[minute]-[second]\");\n    let date_str = timestamp\n        .format(format)\n        .map_err(|e| IoError::other(format!(\"failed to format timestamp: {e}\")))?;\n\n    let filename = format!(\"rollout-{date_str}-{conversation_id}.jsonl\");\n\n    let path = dir.join(filename);\n    let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n        .append(true)\n        .create(true)\n        .open(&amp;path)?;\n\n    Ok(LogFileInfo {\n        file,\n        path,\n        conversation_id,\n        timestamp,\n    })\n}\n\nasync fn rollout_writer(\n    file: tokio::fs::File,",

        "contents": "impl JsonlWriter {\n    async fn write_rollout_item(&amp;mut self, rollout_item: RolloutItem) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        let timestamp_format: &amp;[FormatItem] = format_description!(\n            \"[year]-[month]-[day]T[hour]:[minute]:[second].[subsecond digits:3]Z\"\n        );\n        let timestamp = OffsetDateTime::now_utc()\n            .format(timestamp_format)\n            .map_err(|e| IoError::other(format!(\"failed to format timestamp: {e}\")))?;\n\n        let line = RolloutLine {\n            timestamp,\n            item: rollout_item,\n        };\n        self.write_line(&amp;line).await\n    }\n    async fn write_line(&amp;mut self, item: &amp;impl serde::Serialize) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        let mut json = serde_json::to_string(item)?;\n        json.push('\\n');\n        self.file.write_all(json.as_bytes()).await?;\n        self.file.flush().await?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}",

実装を完了しました。すべてのTODOが完了しています。

## 実装完了サマリー

### 1. `run_console`の完全実装
- `run_dom`と`run_network`と同様に、Native Messaging Hostと通信する実装を追加
- コンソールログ取得のリクエストを送信し、結果を表示

### 2. エラーハンドリングの改善
- タイムアウト処理（30秒）を追加
- 詳細なエラーメッセージを追加
- Native Messaging Hostの起動失敗時の処理を改善
- stderrの読み取りと表示を追加

### 3. `cli_bridge.rs`の改善
- `handle_dom_read`、`handle_console_logs`、`handle_network_logs`の関数を改善
- リクエストパラメータとステータス情報を返す実装に変更
- 拡張機能が処理する必要があることを明示

### 4. 拡張機能との連携
- `connectNative`関数を改善し、自動再接続機能を追加
- 未要求メッセージ（CLIからのリクエストなど）を処理する機能を追加
- 各リクエストハンドラーを改善し、Native Messaging Hostへの結果送信機能を追加

### 5. ドキュメント更新
- `docs/chrome-extension.md`を更新
- 新しいメッセージタイプの説明を追加
- CLIコマンドの使用方法を更新
- 拡張機能との連携に関する注意事項を追加

### 6. 実装ログ作成
- `_docs/2026-01-01_Dom_Console_Network完全実装{main}.md`を作成
- 実装内容、技術詳細、使用方法を記録

すべてのTODOが完了し、Dom、Console、Networkサブコマンドの完全実装が完了しました。CLIからNative Messaging Host経由でこれらの機能を呼び出せるようになりました。

        "contents": "# Codex MCP Server Interface [experimental]\n\nThis document describes Codex’s experimental MCP server interface: a JSON‑RPC API that runs over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport to control a local Codex engine.\n\n- Status: experimental and subject to change without notice\n- Server binary: &#96;codex mcp-server&#96; (or &#96;codex-mcp-server&#96;)\n- Transport: standard MCP over stdio (JSON‑RPC 2.0, line‑delimited)\n\n## Overview\n\nCodex exposes a small set of MCP‑compatible methods to create and manage conversations, send user input, receive live events, and handle approval prompts. The types are defined in &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96; and re‑used by the MCP server implementation in &#96;mcp-server/&#96;.\n\nAt a glance:\n\n- Conversations\n  - &#96;newConversation&#96; → start a Codex session\n  - &#96;sendUserMessage&#96; / &#96;sendUserTurn&#96; → send user input into a conversation\n  - &#96;interruptConversation&#96; → stop the current turn\n  - &#96;listConversations&#96;, &#96;resumeConversation&#96;, &#96;archiveConversation&#96;\n- Configuration and info\n  - &#96;getUserSavedConfig&#96;, &#96;setDefaultModel&#96;, &#96;getUserAgent&#96;, &#96;userInfo&#96;\n  - &#96;model/list&#96; → enumerate available models and reasoning options\n- Auth\n  - &#96;account/read&#96;, &#96;account/login/start&#96;, &#96;account/login/cancel&#96;, &#96;account/logout&#96;, &#96;account/rateLimits/read&#96;\n  - notifications: &#96;account/login/completed&#96;, &#96;account/updated&#96;, &#96;account/rateLimits/updated&#96;\n- Utilities\n  - &#96;gitDiffToRemote&#96;, &#96;execOneOffCommand&#96;\n- Approvals (server → client requests)\n  - &#96;applyPatchApproval&#96;, &#96;execCommandApproval&#96;\n- Notifications (server → client)\n  - &#96;loginChatGptComplete&#96;, &#96;authStatusChange&#96;\n  - &#96;codex/event&#96; stream with agent events\n\nSee code for full type definitions and exact shapes: &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96;.\n\n## Starting the server\n\nRun Codex as an MCP server and connect an MCP client:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex mcp-server | your_mcp_client\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nFor a simple inspection UI, you can also try:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector codex mcp-server\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nUse the separate &#96;codex mcp&#96; subcommand to manage configured MCP server launchers in &#96;config.toml&#96;.\n\n## Conversations\n\nStart a new session with optional overrides:",

        "contents": "# 🔧 Codex MCP Configuration Guide\n\n**Version**: codex-cli 0.47.0-alpha.1  \n**Last Updated**: 2025-10-12  \n**Configuration File**: &#96;~/.cursor/mcp.json&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📋 Overview\n\nThis guide explains how to configure the Codex MCP (Model Context Protocol) server in Cursor IDE to leverage the production-ready meta-orchestration features.\n\n---\n\n## ⚙️ Configuration\n\n### Full &#96;mcp.json&#96; Entry\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"mcpServers\": {\n    \"codex\": {\n      \"command\": \"codex\",\n      \"args\": [\"mcp-server\"],\n      \"env\": {\n        \"RUST_LOG\": \"info\",\n        \"CODEX_CONFIG_PATH\": \"C:\\\\Users\\\\&lt;username&gt;\\\\.codex\\\\config.toml\"\n      },\n      \"description\": \"Codex MCP Server v0.47.0-alpha.1 - Production-Ready Meta-Orchestration System\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ Available Tools\n\n### 1. &#96;codex&#96;\n**Description**: Execute Codex with full capabilities\n\n**CLI Equivalent**: &#96;codex &lt;prompt&gt;&#96;\n\n**Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"tool\": \"codex\",\n  \"arguments\": {\n    \"prompt\": \"Implement user authentication with JWT\",\n    \"config\": {\n      \"model\": \"o3\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 2. &#96;codex-reply&#96;\n**Description**: Continue existing Codex conversation\n\n**Parameters**:\n- &#96;conversationId&#96; (string): Conversation ID to continue\n- &#96;prompt&#96; (string): Next user prompt\n\n**Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"tool\": \"codex-reply\",\n  \"arguments\": {\n    \"conversationId\": \"conv-abc123\",\n    \"prompt\": \"Now add password reset functionality\"\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 3. &#96;codex-supervisor&#96;\n**Description**: Coordinate multiple specialized AI agents\n\n**Parameters**:\n- &#96;goal&#96; (string): High-level goal to accomplish\n- &#96;agents&#96; (array, optional): Specific agent types to use\n- &#96;strategy&#96; (string, optional): Coordination strategy (&#96;sequential&#96;, &#96;parallel&#96;, &#96;hybrid&#96;)\n- &#96;merge_strategy&#96;         "contents": "# 🔧 Codex MCP Configuration Guide\n\n**Version**: codex-cli 0.47.0-alpha.1  \n**Last Updated**: 2025-10-12  \n**Configuration File**: &#96;~/.cursor/mcp.json&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📋 Overview\n\nThis guide explains how to configure the Codex MCP (Model Context Protocol) server in Cursor IDE to leverage the production-ready meta-orchestration features.\n\n---\n\n## ⚙️ Configuration\n\n### Full &#96;mcp.json&#96; Entry\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"mcpServers\": {\n    \"codex\": {\n      \"command\": \"codex\",\n      \"args\": [\"mcp-server\"],\n      \"env\": {\n        \"RUST_LOG\": \"info\",\n        \"CODEX_CONFIG_PATH\": \"C:\\\\Users\\\\&lt;username&gt;\\\\.codex\\\\config.toml\"\n      },\n      \"description\": \"Codex MCP Server v0.47.0-alpha.1 - Production-Ready Meta-Orchestration System\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ Available Tools\n\n### 1. &#96;codex&#96;\n**Description**: Execute Codex with full capabilities\n\n**CLI Equivalent**: &#96;codex &lt;prompt&gt;&#96;\n\n**Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"tool\": \"codex\",\n  \"arguments\": {\n    \"prompt\": \"Implement user authentication with JWT\",\n    \"config\": {\n      \"model\": \"o3\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 2. &#96;codex-reply&#96;\n**Description**: Continue existing Codex conversation\n\n**Parameters**:\n- &#96;conversationId&#96; (string): Conversation ID to continue\n- &#96;prompt&#96; (string): Next user prompt\n\n**Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"tool\": \"codex-reply\",\n  \"arguments\": {\n    \"conversationId\": \"conv-abc123\",\n    \"prompt\": \"Now add password reset functionality\"\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 3. &#96;codex-supervisor&#96;\n**Description**: Coordinate multiple specialized AI agents\n\n**Parameters**:\n- &#96;goal&#96; (string): High-level goal to accomplish\n- &#96;agents&#96; (array, optional): Specific agent types to use\n- &#96;strategy&#96; (string, optional): Coordination strategy (&#96;sequential&#96;, &#96;parallel&#96;, &#96;hybrid&#96;)\n- &#96;merge_strategy&#96; (string, optional): Result merging (&#96;concatenate&#96;, &#96;voting&#96;, &#96;highest_score&#96;)\n\n**Available Agents**:\n- &#96;CodeExpert&#96; - Code implementation and refactoring\n- &#96;Researcher&#96; - Technology research and best practices\n- &#96;Tester&#96; - Test generation and coverage analysis\n- &#96;Security&#96; - Security audits and vulnerability scanning\n- &#96;Backend&#96; - Backend architecture and APIs",

        },
        "contents": "# 🔌 Codex MCP 統合セットアップガイド\n\n**Version**: 0.47.0-alpha.1  \n**Last Updated**: 2025-10-13  \n**Status**: 🚧 Phase 2 実装中\n\n&gt; **概要**: Codex 自身を MCP サーバー化し、サブエージェントから Codex の全機能を使えるようにする\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 目的\n\nCodex を Model Context Protocol (MCP) サーバーとして動作させ、サブエージェントが以下の機能を使えるようにする：\n\n- ✅ &#96;codex_read_file&#96; - Codex 経由でファイル読み取り\n- ✅ &#96;codex_grep&#96; - Codex 経由で grep 検索\n- ✅ &#96;codex_codebase_search&#96; - セマンティック検索\n- ✅ &#96;codex_apply_patch&#96; - パッチ適用（書き込み権限必要）\n- ⚠️ &#96;codex_shell&#96; - シェルコマンド実行（危険なため通常は許可しない）\n\n---\n\n## 📋 前提条件\n\n### 必要なもの\n\n1. ✅ Codex CLI がインストール済み\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   codex --version\n   # 期待: codex-cli 0.47.0-alpha.1\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. ✅ OpenAI API キーが設定済み\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   echo $OPENAI_API_KEY  # Linux/macOS\n   echo $env:OPENAI_API_KEY  # Windows PowerShell\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. ✅ Rust ツールチェインがインストール済み（開発用）\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   rustc --version\n   cargo --version\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🚀 セットアップ手順\n\n### ステップ 1: 設定ファイルの作成\n\n&#96;~/.codex/config.toml&#96; に Codex MCP サーバーの設定を追加：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n# ~/.codex/config.toml\n\n# ==================== 基本設定 ====================\nmodel = \"gpt-4o\"\n\n[model_providers.openai]\nbase_url = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"\nenv_key = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\"\nwire_api = \"chat\"\n\n# ==================== セキュリティ ====================\n[sandbox]\ndefault_mode = \"read-only\"\n\n[approval]\npolicy = \"on-request\"\n\n# ==================== MCP サーバー ====================\n# Codex 自身を MCP サーバーとして使用\n[mcp_servers.codex-agent]\ncommand = \"codex\"\nargs = [\"mcp-server\"]\nenv.RUST_LOG = \"info\"\nenv.CODEX_CONFIG_PATH = \"~/.codex/config.toml\"",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "# 🔌 Codex MCP 統合セットアップガイド\n\n**Version**: 0.47.0-alpha.1  \n**Last Updated**: 2025-10-13  \n**Status**: 🚧 Phase 2 実装中\n\n&gt; **概要**: Codex 自身を MCP サーバー化し、サブエージェントから Codex の全機能を使えるようにする\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 目的\n\nCodex を Model Context Protocol (MCP) サーバーとして動作させ、サブエージェントが以下の機能を使えるようにする：\n\n- ✅ &#96;codex_read_file&#96; - Codex 経由でファイル読み取り\n- ✅ &#96;codex_grep&#96; - Codex 経由で grep 検索\n- ✅ &#96;codex_codebase_search&#96; - セマンティック検索\n- ✅ &#96;codex_apply_patch&#96; - パッチ適用（書き込み権限必要）\n- ⚠️ &#96;codex_shell&#96; - シェルコマンド実行（危険なため通常は許可しない）\n\n---\n\n## 📋 前提条件\n\n### 必要なもの\n\n1. ✅ Codex CLI がインストール済み\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   codex --version\n   # 期待: codex-cli 0.47.0-alpha.1\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. ✅ OpenAI API キーが設定済み\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   echo $OPENAI_API_KEY  # Linux/macOS\n   echo $env:OPENAI_API_KEY  # Windows PowerShell\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. ✅ Rust ツールチェインがインストール済み（開発用）\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   rustc --version\n   cargo --version\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🚀 セットアップ手順\n\n### ステップ 1: 設定ファイルの作成\n\n&#96;~/.codex/config.toml&#96; に Codex MCP サーバーの設定を追加：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n# ~/.codex/config.toml\n\n# ==================== 基本設定 ====================\nmodel = \"gpt-4o\"\n\n[model_providers.openai]\nbase_url = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"\nenv_key = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\"\nwire_api = \"chat\"\n\n# ==================== セキュリティ ====================\n[sandbox]\ndefault_mode = \"read-only\"\n\n[approval]\npolicy = \"on-request\"\n\n# ==================== MCP サーバー ====================\n# Codex 自身を MCP サーバーとして使用\n[mcp_servers.codex-agent]\ncommand = \"codex\"\nargs = [\"mcp-server\"]\nenv.RUST_LOG = \"info\"\nenv.CODEX_CONFIG_PATH = \"~/.codex/config.toml\"",

        },
        "contents": "Currently, &#96;CODEX_SANDBOX_NETWORK_DISABLED=1&#96; is also added to the environment, assuming network is disabled. This is not configurable.\n\n## MCP integration\n\n### mcp_servers\n\nYou can configure Codex to use [MCP servers](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/about) to give Codex access to external applications, resources, or services.\n\n#### Server configuration\n\n##### STDIO\n\n[STDIO servers](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-06-18/basic/transports#stdio) are MCP servers that you can launch directly via commands on your computer.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n# The top-level table name must be &#96;mcp_servers&#96;\n# The sub-table name (&#96;server-name&#96; in this example) can be anything you would like.\n[mcp_servers.server_name]\ncommand = \"npx\"\n# Optional\nargs = [\"-y\", \"mcp-server\"]\n# Optional: propagate additional env vars to the MCP server.\n# A default whitelist of env vars will be propagated to the MCP server.\n# https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/rmcp-client/src/utils.rs#L82\nenv = { \"API_KEY\" = \"value\" }\n# or\n[mcp_servers.server_name.env]\nAPI_KEY = \"value\"\n# Optional: Additional list of environment variables that will be whitelisted in the MCP server's environment.\nenv_vars = [\"API_KEY2\"]\n\n# Optional: cwd that the command will be run from\ncwd = \"/Users/&lt;user&gt;/code/my-server\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n##### Streamable HTTP\n\n[Streamable HTTP servers](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-06-18/basic/transports#streamable-http) enable Codex to talk to resources that are accessed via a http url (either on localhost or another domain).\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[mcp_servers.figma]\nurl = \"https://mcp.figma.com/mcp\"\n# Optional environment variable containing a bearer token to use for auth\nbearer_token_env_var = \"ENV_VAR\"\n# Optional map of headers with hard-coded values.\nhttp_headers = { \"HEADER_NAME\" = \"HEADER_VALUE\" }\n# Optional map of headers whose values will be replaced with the environment variable.\nenv_http_headers = { \"HEADER_NAME\" = \"ENV_VAR\" }\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nStreamable HTTP connections always use the Rust MCP client under the hood. Run &#96;codex mcp login &lt;server-name&gt;&#96; to authenticate for servers supporting OAuth.\n\n#### Other configuration options\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
        "signatures": {},
